verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Meridian logo to an illegible speck floating above the suitcase. It splits the art, with the sunglasses stranded far left and the suitcase cut off from its circle, and the CTA sits on top of the blue circle, so the layout reads as scattered fragments. B keeps the headline, subcopy and CTA as one block with a readable logo, but the logo is jammed against the CTA instead of leading the layout, the headline hugs the top edge, the circle is cropped at the bottom, and about 150px of dead space sits on the left.
